deadline.value: PhD enrolment at UC can begin on the first day of any month of the year; UC Doctoral Scholarships close 15 May 2027 for a second-half 2027 start.
deadline.quote: You may begin your PhD on the first day of any month of the year.

also.quote: There are two application rounds each year with deadlines of October 15th and May 15th

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the official pages checked for this PhD.

supervisor.value: You must contact a potential supervisor before applying, and written evidence of their agreement must be included in the myUC application.
supervisor.quote: PhD students must contact a potential supervisor before applying.

also.quote: This evidence of supervision must be included in your application in myUC for your application to be assessed.

funding.value: The most common PhD funding is a UC doctoral scholarship, applied for in rounds. International students can apply for these with the same process.
funding.quote: The most common form of funding for PhD candidates are UC doctoral scholarships

also.quote: similar UC doctoral scholarships are available for international students

entry_route.value: Students with a good honours or master's degree can enrol for the PhD, so both routes are accepted.
entry_route.quote: Students with a good honours or masters degree can enrol for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy.

notes: PhD in Mathematics on the School of Mathematics and Statistics page. The school page also says international students pay the domestic tuition rate for PhD study. Computational and Applied Mathematical Sciences is a separate official PhD subject and is not mapped here.
